_meta.description: Actual end-of-season player awards in each top-5 league, for the award check in Project 03. Every winner was checked against the source page on 2026-10-27. Names follow FBref's spelling so they match the data; born_year separates namesakes. Schema: {winner, award, source} per league and season (winner null where no award was given).

awards.Premier League: PFA Players' Player of the Year (voted by professionals)
awards.La Liga: Trofeo Alfredo Di Stéfano (Marca's best player of La Liga; La Liga's own award was not given 2016-17 to 2022-23)
awards.Serie A: Serie A MVP (Lega Serie A, since 2018-19); 2017-18: Serie A Footballer of the Year (AIC, Gran Galà del Calcio)
awards.Bundesliga: VDV Player of the Season (voted by Bundesliga professionals)
awards.Ligue 1: UNFP Ligue 1 Player of the Year (voted by professionals)

caveats: Award definitions differ by league: three are voted by players, one by a newspaper, one by the league.
Calendar-year awards (Ballon d'Or) are mapped to the season that ends in that year (2017-2018 -> 2018).
2019-2020: the Ballon d'Or and the UNFP Ligue 1 award were not given (COVID-19).
